title: Personal Training Packages: when a package lapses to expired
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the timing basis on which a package lapses to expired.

## Rule
A package lapses once the current moment is not before the package's own purchase date plus the tier's own expiration window, counted as full calendar days from the purchase date with no partial-day rounding.

~~its remaining sessions are forfeited~~ This clause is no longer in force for what happens to the package's remaining sessions at the moment of lapsing; the current basis for how many sessions are actually forfeited is stated in the membership-grace-credit-against-forfeited-sessions and resolving-the-number-of-sessions-forfeited-at-lapse documents for this product.

## Points of judgement
The lapse clock starts running from the package's own purchase date, exactly as recorded on the package, and runs forward by the tier's own expiration window in full calendar days. A package that reaches exactly the day the window elapses has already lapsed on that day, since the comparison is not-before rather than strictly-after: the boundary day itself counts as lapsed, not the day after it. A package still within the window one calendar day earlier has not yet lapsed on that earlier day. This timing basis governs only whether and when the lapse itself occurs; it applies uniformly across every tier, each of which sets its own expiration window length.
